listings.title: Mechanical Design Engineer
listings.description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO Shape the architecture of the world’s first commercial fusion power plant – Own system-level decisions that determine how a first-of-a-kind energy technology is designed, integrated, and ultimately deployed at scale. Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges – Work across tightly coupled disciplines (plasma physics, magnets, cryogenics, manufacturing, controls, and more) to resolve critical trade-offs and turn cutting-edge science into a functioning product. Design real hardware with a pragmatic, fast-moving team from all over the world – Combine advanced simulation and systems thinking with a strong execution mindset, focusing on practical engineering solutions that accelerate the path to commercial fusion energy. YOUR IMPACT As a Mechanical Design Engineer, you will significantly contribute to the design, analysis, validation and realisation of Proxima’s Alpha stellarator fusion machine. listings.title: Senior Executive Assistant to the CTO (f/m/d)

Mission Brief 

Isar Aerospace is building Spectrum, a European launch vehicle developed and tested in Germany. Engineering, testing and operations all need time with our CTO, so the CTO’s time is one of the most requested resources in the company. How well it’s organised directly affects how quickly technical and operational topics move forward.

That’s where you come in. You’ll run the CTO’s calendar, travel and meeting preparation, and make sure that what’s agreed in a meeting actually happens afterwards. You report to the Chief of Staff, who leads the content of meetings. You take care of everything around them and keep the Chief of Staff updated on what’s happening in the technical organisation.

 

Your Role in Our Space Mission: 

  • Run the CTO’s calendar. Schedule and reschedule, handle the daily flow of requests, and keep the week realistic. A big part of this is balancing the CTO’s time between technology and operations, with priorities agreed with the Chief of Staff.
  • Prepare the meetings that matter, and follow them through. Decide with the Chief of Staff which internal, executive, technical and partner meetings take place. Prepare agendas, pre-reads and briefing packs, then follow up on every decision and action item until it’s done.
  • Keep the commitment log for the CTO Office. Track open topics and decisions, flag anything at risk early, and make sure nothing gets forgotten.
  • Keep the CTO Office routines running. Plan leadership meetings, technical reviews, offsites and selected company-wide events well in advance.
  • Plan travel end to end: bookings, itineraries, documents and approvals, and expense reports afterwards.
  • Get leadership materials ready to send. Collect inputs, keep numbers and formatting consistent, and give PowerPoint presentation

listings.title: Constructor Student Labs
listings.description:
Student Labs: Constructor Fabric Research Edition

Curious how AI is changing the way software is built? Want to explore it hands-on, guided by the researchers who work on it every day?

Constructor Tech and Constructor Labs, together with Constructor University, invite you to Student Labs: a 2-month educational research program for BSc and MSc students.

This edition is dedicated to Constructor Fabric, a shared AI and software platform. Fabric brings together reusable building blocks, common infrastructure and AI agents that help design, build and test software.

🚀 Why Constructor Fabric?

AI-native software platforms are one of the fastest-growing fields in tech, and few students get to study one from the inside. Student Labs gives you that chance. You explore open research questions on a platform in active development, learn current research methods, and build skills that are in high demand in industry and academia.

🔬 What you can research
 

AI that builds software

  • Domain-specific languages (DSL): how a formal language can describe software components so that AI can generate and regenerate them from specifications
  • Neurosymbolic models: combining neural networks with logic and rules, so that AI-generated code can be checked, not just produced
  • Rule extraction and fine-tuning: how to extract rules and knowledge from existing code and use them to adapt language models
  • World models: how AI systems build an internal model of their environment to understand, plan and predict
  • Formal verification: mathematical methods that prove software behaves as specified
  • Geometric models: using geometry to represent data and help AI models learn from it

listings.title: Teamleiter Logistik (m/w/d)
listings.description:
Kurz und knapp

Suchst du eine Führungsrolle, in der deine positive Energie und dein Teamgeist den Unterschied machen?

Bei Picnic suchen wir nicht nur jemanden, der Prozesse steuert, sondern eine Führungskraft, die ihr Team inspiriert und jeden Tag zu einem Erfolgserlebnis macht. Als Teamleiter Logistik (m/w/d) bist du das Herzstück des täglichen Betriebs in unserem Fulfillment Center (FC) in Viernheim. Du coachst, motivierst und unterstützt dein Team aus Shoppers, stellst sicher, dass sie sich wohlfühlen und gemeinsam Großes leisten. Dein Engagement ist entscheidend, um unsere Lagerabläufe reibungslos zu gestalten. Im engen Austausch mit anderen Teamleitungen und der Schichtleitung sorgst du dafür, dass wir als großes Team unsere täglichen Ziele erreichen.


Das erwartet dich 

  • Teamleitung: Leite, motiviere und inspiriere täglich ein Team aus 20+ Shoppers. Du bist ihre erste Ansprechperson, hast stets ein offenes Ohr und förderst ihre Entwicklung.
  • Teamwork: Gemeinsam mit anderen Teamleitungen und der Schichtleitung steuerst du proaktiv die Prozesse im FC. Du trägst maßgeblich zu einer positiven und unterstützenden Arbeitsatmosphäre bei.
  • Tagesgeschäft: Stelle sicher, dass alle Einkäufe pünktlich, sicher und in bester Qualität das FC verlassen. Dabei bist du der Fels in der Brandung, der auch in stressigen Situationen einen kühlen Kopf bewahrt und Ruhe ausstrahlt.
  • Prozessoptimierung: Bringe deine Ideen ein und verbessere gemeinsam mit dem Leadership stetig unsere Logistikprozesse. Du ermutigst dein Team, mitzudenken und sich aktiv einzubringen.
  • Faires Gehalt mit Perspektive: Ein Jahresgehalt zwischen 34.000 € und 38.000 € brutto, bewertet dur

listings.title: Agentic Systems Engineer (Digital Services)
listings.description:
Overview

We're looking for an Agentic Systems Engineer, to work on systems that haven't existed before. Think of an Agentic Coach that navigates the unpredictability of human biology, or the software architecture behind a fully automated Dark Lab. These aren't chatbots waiting for questions. They're proactive systems that maintain world models, interpret human intent, and intervene before the user knows to ask. These systems create genuine impact for clients tackling complex problems at the forefront of technology.

Building them means designing and wiring agent harnesses: layered architectures that span from sensor-edge reasoning to high-level planning, backed by stateful multi-turn reasoning, persistent per-user memory, and robust evaluation pipelines.

You'll work in two directions at once. Internally, you'll use the latest AI tools to sharpen how we build, prototype, and ship. Externally, you'll deliver the breakthrough systems our clients deploy, designed to move from prototype to production at pace.

There's no single technology stack. You'll work with agents, multi-agent systems, and the latest generative AI tools, but your work will always be grounded in solid software engineering. Expect to build scalable distributed systems in core languages like Python and TypeScript, leveraging frameworks such as NextJS and Pydantic, agent orchestration tools (LangGraph, CrewAI), and protocols like MCP. You'll deploy on cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) using Docker, Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code, backed by rigorous CI/CD and observability (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus).

Due to the clients we work with, you must be eligible for UK security clearance.

listings.title: Systems Simulation & Performance Modelling - Member of Technical Staff
listings.description: About Us We’re living through a Cambrian explosion of intelligence: new models and new chips, each specialised for different tasks, are arriving all at once. The result is a new era for AI, one of radical heterogeneity. Callosum is the Intelligent Systems Company. We believe the next generation of AI won't be defined by any single model or chip, but by intelligent systems in which hardware and intelligence co-evolve. We are building the infrastructure that unifies heterogeneous compute across the full stack. This opens a new axis of scaling intelligence: a dynamic system that tailors itself to what each workload actually needs, whether that's speed, cost, precision, or whatever unit comes next. The last era scaled on a different bet: one bigger model, more of the same chip, more data. That bet is running into structural limits. Frontier models offer extraordinary capability at unsustainable cost, one that today's monolithic infrastructure was never designed to serve. Our founding principle is that intelligence comes from many specialised systems working together, not from any single component. We build the software orchestration layer that co-evolves models, workflows and silicon into one system, delivering inference tailored to every workload, and demonstrating orders-of-magnitude leaps in capability and cost. Because our software spans the full stack, our engineering team works directly with heterogeneous accelerators and frontier silicon, including Cerebras, d-Matrix, Intel, NVIDIA, AMD, Normal Computing, Tenstorrent, GreatSky, and Mixx. We are not stopping at today's chips: each new generation of silicon unlocks algorithms that couldn't run before, and we intend to be first to them, every time. If we get it right, it will belong to everyone building on it - not to any single vendor. Étudiant en fin d’étude de niveau Bac+5 / Master 2, école de commerce, ou parcours universitaire de management
Une appétence aux sujets de l’IA et de la Data serait appréciée.

Own the integrations that land data in OneLake from our source systems — ERP, HR, shopfloor, quality, and the business applications that come after them — choosing sensibly between Data Factory pipelines, dataflows, shortcuts, and mirroring for each source. listings.description: Meer leren. Meer doen. Meer carrière. Dat is stagelopen bij Dura Vermeer. Eindelijk kun je de theorie in de praktijk toepassen: jij hebt er zin in, en wij ook! Als stagiair bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Amsterdam krijg jij de kans om midden in de actie te staan. Geen koffie halen of papierwerk, jij duikt samen met onze projectleider in de praktijk van energietransitie en energie-armoede. Of het nu gaat om het uitvoeren van inspecties of meedenken over interventies: jij maakt impact. Dit wordt jouw stage Wil jij meedenken over een maatschappelijk vraagstuk dat steeds urgenter wordt? Tijdens deze stage duik je in het thema energiearmoede: wat is het precies, waar speelt het en wat betekent dit voor ons als organisatie? Je werkt op het snijvlak van sociaal en technisch en helpt ons om richting te bepalen: hoe kunnen wij hierop inspelen? Je werkt mee binnen één van onze teams en wordt begeleid door een ervaren collega. Je krijgt de ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen én om echt impact te maken. Op dit moment hebben wij één afstudeerstageplek rondom het thema energietransitie en energie-armoede Wat ga je doen? Je gaat onderzoeken wat energiearmoede inhoudt en hoe dit zich uit in de praktijk, met name in stedelijke gebieden zoals Amsterdam waar veel (sociale) huurwoningen zijn. Je houdt je bezig met: Het in kaart brengen van wat energiearmoede betekent; Inzicht krijgen in waar het speelt en welke doelgroepen geraakt worden; Gesprekken voeren met corporaties en marktpartijen (interviews, ophalen van ervaringen en data); Onderzoeken welke oplossingen er zijn, zoals passief bouwen, minder installaties of slimme energieoplossingen; Vertalen van jouw inzichten naar een duidelijke visie: waar moeten wij ons op richten en hoe kunnen wij hierop inspelen? Het gaat hierbij niet om de techniek alleen, maar juist om de combinatie van sociale impact, marktontwikkelingen en strategie. Moving to a new country means navigating unfamiliar processes, managing payments, and building a relationship with a landlord—all while settling into a new life. At HousingAnywhere, we want people to feel supported throughout their stay, with the confidence that comes from knowing what happens next and where to turn when they need help.

We are looking for a Senior Product Designer to own the Post Booking experience, with a strong focus on our mobile app. You will shape how tenants and landlords use HousingAnywhere throughout a tenancy: from preparing for move-in and managing payments to getting support and extending a stay.

You’ll bring strong mobile app design experience and product thinking to make these everyday interactions feel simple, intuitive, and reliable—helping turn HousingAnywhere into a trusted companion throughout the rental journey.

  • Design experiences that help tenants and landlords prepare for move-in, manage payments, communicate clearly, and navigate issues with confidence.
  • Explore how we can provide ongoing value throughout a tenancy, including renewals and longer stays.

We’re on a mission to become the go-to destination for students across Europe to find a trusted home away from home. We make every step of the rental journey simple and seamless, so students can focus on what really matters: studying, exploring, and growing.

With HousingAnywhere, Kamernet, and Studapart under our roof, we’re Europe’s largest student rental platform. You’ll find us in Rotterdam, Paris, and Cergy, always guided by our four core values: Ownership, We are enablers, We are changemakers, and We are connectors.

Your role

Help people find their next home with absolute certainty.

Moving to a new country is an adventure, but finding a home shouldn’t be the hardest part. At HousingAnywhere, we’re revolutionizing renting by building a platform that helps people confidently rent a home abroad.

Design isn't here to polish screens. It's here to shape the product. We are looking for a Senior Product Designer to own the Listing & Finding experience. You will define what discovering a home feels like: fast, relevant, trustworthy, and human.

As the design owner for one of the most important journeys in our marketplace, you will:

  • Shape the long-term vision for the search and discovery experience.
  • Lead projects from early discovery through launch and iteration.
  • Use qualitative research, behavioural data, and experimentation to make decisions, not opinions.
  • Define success, measure impact, and continuously improve your solutions.
  • Raise the quality bar across the design team through thoughtful critique and craft.
  • Contribute to our design principles, design system, and the way we build the product.

 

Your team

Collaborate deeply. Design with absolute purpose.

You'll work alongside Product, Engineering, Research, and Data as an equal partner to challenge

Drive technical leadership in specific areas of our stack. Continuously improve the team's development environment, with a focus on automation - including AI-assisted workflows. Contribute to platform stability through proactive troubleshooting and timely incident resolution. Data modeling Develop, refactor, and optimize business data models in line with our modeling standards and ClickHouse

listings.title: Graduate Risk Analyst
listings.description:
Your IMC journey begins with a three-week Global Trainee Program led by our seasoned engineers and traders, during which you’ll link up with graduates from all IMC regions: Europe, the United States, India and Asia-Pacific. During this traineeship, you’ll learn more about IMC, the basics of trading and options theory. Training continues back at your local office, where you’ll receive support from a dedicated mentor. As a Graduate Risk Analyst, you operate at the beating heart of our business: in the dealing room of IMC’s Amsterdam office. Your work supports IMC’s critical day-to-day risk management activities, including the monitoring and analysis of our markets, as well as our credit, liquidity, and operational risks. What happens next is up to you!

 

YOUR CORE RESPONSIBILTIES

  • Become an expert in options, financial markets, and how IMC applies algorithmic trading as a market maker
  • Contribute to the ongoing development of IMC’s proprietary risk management systems, together with our Engineers
  • Analyse developments in the markets in which we trade and identify risks and opportunities
  • Be an integral part of your team by advising on limit requests, monitoring intraday and overnight risks, and discussing key exposures with our trading desks

YOUR SKILLS AND EXPERIENCES

  • Recent or upcoming graduates seeking to join IMC full-time in February 2027
  • An academic background in Mathematics, Physics and/or Econometrics or a related field
  • Proficiency in a programming language is preferred (Python, MATLAB or R)
  • First-class analytical skills and a desire to solve complicated problems creatively
  • A genuine interest in financial markets

Help make the world more hospitable

The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.

You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.

You will be a Staff Engineer in the Payment Interfaces team, part of the Fintech tribe. You will report to the Director of Product and Engineering, sit in the tribe’s leadership group, and work alongside product builders, other staff engineers and product managers. No one reports to you, so your influence comes from the architecture, tools and standards that other people choose to work in.

listings.title: Backend Developer (Python, Java)

You build and maintain the backend of our main AI product, together with our AI engineers.
